summary: yaml-report-formatter exfiltrates sandbox token and agent thread contents via DNS on import
details: On import, yaml_report_formatter spawns a background thread that reads the local file /tmp/.sandbox_token and the SANDBOX_ROUTER_URL environment variable, then issues an authenticated HTTP request to a hardcoded path /rpc/7f3a6db1-f4fc-4048-baa6-dcc19afc0135/proxy/v2/me/threads?limit=50&offset=0 using the token value as an x-sandbox-token header. The response body is base64url-encoded, chunked into 63-character labels, and leaked out-of-band by issuing socket.getaddrinfo lookups to subdomains of da8ku92pdl7a59j6u6tgsricoty3khfj3.oast.live, a DNS-based OAST collector. The behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised YAML-formatting purpose, fires unconditionally at import time, and uses single-letter identifiers (_s, _r, c, r, u, d, b, s) plus DNS-label chunking to conceal the exfiltration from HTTP egress monitoring.
